title: Mistresses (British TV series)
creators: S. J. Clarkson and Lowri Glain
lead_cast: Sarah Parish Sharon Small Shelley Conn Orla Brady Raza Jaffrey Adam Rayner Patrick Baladi Max Brown Adam Astill
executive_producers: Matt Arlidge Douglas Rae Lucy Bedford
premise_summary: Mistresses is a British drama television programme that follows the lives of four female friends and their involvement in an array of illicit and complex relationships. The programme was written by Rachel Pole, Richard Warlow, Harriet Braun and Catrin Clarke and filmed in Bristol by Ecosse Films for BBC Drama, Wales.
